artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the spine label is illegible and distorted. It resembles characters but lacks coherent letterforms, a common AI artifact where text generation fails to produce readable strings.

The dotted line design on the cover appears slightly uneven in dot spacing and alignment. While this could be a stylistic choice, it lacks the perfect geometric precision expected from printed manufacturing, suggesting slight generative inconsistency.

The white pages at the top merge slightly into the black cover without a sharp, distinct boundary. The edge of the paper block looks somewhat soft and undefined rather than crisp individual sheets or a solid block.
